source_statement: For any already stored finite real tensor train C with arbitrary natural bonds, the specified deterministic backward stored thin-LQ canonicalization returns the same concrete data as ConstructiveTensorTrain.canonicalize after storage erasure, preserves every word and terminal label, produces right-canonical cores with no larger maximum bond, and moves full chain mass to its actual residual boundary. The same producer's eight-counter extended exact-real total is at most n*(176*D^3+116*D^2+29*D+8)+5*D^2+4*D+6 under maxBond(C)<=D. No input-core generation, finite-bit/runtime/peak-memory, physical primitive or Hermite ROOT theorem is included.
